description: ST. CLOUD (KNSI) — Senator Aric Putnam hosted a roundtable on senior care at the Great River Regional Library in St. Cloud, where about 35 to 40 people talked about staying in their homes, staying connected to their neighbors, and the volunteer shortage that affects both.
